work.title: Behind the camera
work.description:
Another milestone achieved! 🚀
 EventCast Maldives has successfully completed the Video Replay checks for the Thinadhoo City WDC Hiyala Handball Tournament 7, 2025 - marking the first ever implementation of video replay in the history of Maldivian handball. 🇲🇻🔥
 This remarkable achievement was made possible through the passion, precision, and unwavering dedication of our entire team. When innovation meets commitment, history is created and today, we’ve raised the benchmark higher than ever before. 💯
 Our deepest appreciation goes out to our exceptional crew for bringing this vision to life and elevating the standards of sports broadcasting in the Maldives. 🎥✨
 We also extend our sincere thanks to Havaru Sports, Thinadhoo City WDC, and the Referees for their trust, support, and partnership in enabling us to take the game to the next level. 🙌
 Here’s to greater milestones, groundbreaking innovations, and countless unforgettable moments ahead. 🚀✨

 EventCast Maldives has successfully completed the Video Replay checks for the Thinadhoo City WDC Hiyala Handball Tournament 7, 2025 - marking the first ever implementation of video replay in the history of Maldivian handball. 🇲🇻🔥
 This remarkable achievement was made possible through the passion, precision, and unwavering dedication of our entire team. When innovation meets commitment, history is created and today, we’ve raised the benchmark higher than ever before. 💯
 Our deepest appreciation goes out to our exceptional crew for bringing this vision to life and elevating the standards of sports broadcasting in the Maldives. 🎥✨
 We also extend our sincere thanks to Havaru Sports, Thinadhoo City WDC, and the Referees for their trust, support, and partnership in enabling us to take the game to the next level. 🙌
 Here’s to greater milestones, groundbreaking innovations, and countless unforgettable moments ahead. 🚀✨
work.alt: Two production staff monitor screens at a desk with a cooling fan.
